New York: Movado Group is selling 95% of EBEL for $66.5 million, keeping a 5% stake, to a group led by F.P. Journe's parent with Chanel.

Filed with the SEC on 8 October, it carves EBEL — founded in La Chaux-de-Fonds in 1911 — into a new Swiss subsidiary, the Villa Turque, a Le Corbusier house, among the transferred assets.

New York: Blue Nile is converting its 23 showrooms into stores with sellable inventory, Signet CFO Joan Hilson said in an interview published 7 October.

Hilson said 90% of Blue Nile's transactions above $5,000 are natural diamonds. The division bought The Clear Cut, a gemologist concierge desk; staff trained on the new handoff at a session in New York.
